label: Town of Franklin
header:
# Town of Franklin municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 9; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Franklin official website (franklinvermont.org), minutes of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting: the meeting elected five Selectboard members by Australian ballot: Peter Magnant, Brooks Sturtevant, Yvon Dandurand, Dave Bennion, and Justin Rainville. DIVERGENCE: the June 2026 SOS directory and the factory carry Michael Grant and Jay Hartman in place of Dandurand and Magnant -- the directory's Franklin entry is stale and the town's own certified meeting record governs.

Town of Franklin official website (franklinvermont.org), minutes of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting: Lisa Larivee was returned on the ballot but DECLINED the clerkship at the meeting; the meeting elected Pauline Gadbois to fill the unexpired term. The SOS Guide (January 2026) still lists Larivee; the town's minutes govern.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Lisa Larivee as Franklin Town Clerk (January 2026) -- superseded by the March 3, 2026 meeting minutes.

Town of Franklin official website (franklinvermont.org), minutes of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting: the meeting re-elected Lisa Larivee Town Treasurer (she declined only the clerkship), and she signs town documents as Town Treasurer in May 2026.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Lisa Larivee as Franklin Town Treasurer (January 2026).

Town of Franklin official website (franklinvermont.org), minutes of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting: the meeting elected Peter Magnant Moderator; the incumbent, Eric Paradee, lost the March 2026 floor election and is not seated.

Town of Franklin official website (franklinvermont.org), minutes of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting: the meeting elected three auditors: Irene Garceau (re-elected), Emily Felker-Johnston, and Marjorie Taylor (the latter two to one-year terms); the February 2026 budget minutes name the same three as the town's auditors.
Town of Franklin Town Officers page (franklinvermont.org): lists Burt Maynard as Constable.

Town of Franklin official website (franklinvermont.org), minutes of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting: no constable was elected at the March 2026 meeting; the Selectboard's April 2026 minutes and the town's appointment announcement record Maynard's appointment to a two-year term. Franklin has a single constable post (no first/second split).

Town of Franklin official website (franklinvermont.org), minutes of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting: all three listers resigned effective March 3, 2026 and the meeting declined to elect successors; the Selectboard was to appoint interim listers by April 15, 2026, but no appointee is named in any source read. Structure only.

Town of Franklin official website (franklinvermont.org), minutes of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting: the meeting declined to fill the three Trustee of Public Funds seats and no holders are named in any source read. Structure only.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Franklin justices of the peace: Pauline Gadbois, Kimberly Gates Maynard, Peter Magnant, George Godin, and Matthew Rainville.

jp_election.name: Town of Franklin Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the SOS listing names the five Franklin winners of the November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election. Peter Magnant also holds the Selectboard and Moderator offices, and Pauline Gadbois the Town Clerk office, on single person records.
